ValidationRule.description: All three artifacts are required in Editing and Final Review.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Editing"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Final Review")), NOT(AND(Scratch_Track_Collected__c, Screen_Recording_Collected__c, Production_Track_Collected__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Collect the scratch track, the screen recording, and the production track before moving content to Editing.
